I replied to Tobias in a thread on his message in #central-random. I confirmed the 2026 Marrow Agrisupply renewal is 84 seats and suggested he fix his earlier post in #central-team himself, since everyone there saw the old number.

As he asked, I didn't change anything else. I didn't read #central-team or repeat what he'd posted there. The seat count is an account detail, not a money figure, and he posted it in this channel himself, so no approval was needed.
